dialogue.content: こんばんは、遅いスタートですが大丈夫ですか?
dialogue.English: Good evening. It’s a late start—are you okay with that?

dialogue.content: こんばんは！ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Good evening! Thank you!

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします！
dialogue.English: I look forward to our session!

dialogue.content: 22時30分をめどにがんばります。
dialogue.English: We'll aim to finish around 10:30 p.m.

dialogue.content: はい！よろしくお願いします！！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you! I appreciate it!

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。初めに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか?
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんばんは38歳女性です。よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. I’m a 38-year-old woman. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。38歳、女性の方ですね。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか? お聞かせいただけますか?
dialogue.English: Thank you. A 38-year-old woman. What brings you in today? Could you tell me about it?

dialogue.content: はい、じつは、お友達が死んでしまいました
dialogue.English: Yes, actually, a friend of mine has passed away.

dialogue.content: 重たい話でごめんなさい
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for starting with such a heavy topic.

dialogue.content: えっ❕いえいえ、それは本当につらいお話しですね。
dialogue.English: Oh! No, not at all. That must be truly painful for you.

dialogue.content: 37歳で、ひとしれず膵臓癌と闘ってたみたいです
dialogue.English: She was 37, and it seems she was secretly battling pancreatic cancer.

dialogue.content: はい、はい、
dialogue.English: I see, I see.

dialogue.content: 知らなかったんです
dialogue.English: I didn't know.

dialogue.content: ご存じなかったんですか・・・本当につらいですよね。
dialogue.English: You didn't know... That must be so difficult.

dialogue.content: 日に日に辛い気持ちが増してきて……最初は、意味がわからずただただびっくりしただけで。。
dialogue.English: The painful feelings are growing day by day... At first, I couldn't process it and was just shocked.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、でもわかります。日に日にということが、色々な思いでとともに・・・いろんなことを思い出すんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: I can imagine, and I understand. When you say "day by day," I suppose various memories and feelings come back to you... you probably remember many things.

dialogue.content: はい。偶然、2度も同じ職場で働いた友達です。
dialogue.English: Yes. She was a friend I coincidentally worked with at the same workplace twice.

dialogue.content: 周りの方もだれも知らなかったのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: Did no one else around her know either?

dialogue.content: 職場の方は?
dialogue.English: What about her colleagues?

dialogue.content: そうです。彼女は、ご主人のことが大好きで、ご主人とばかり行動してました。
dialogue.English: That's right. She loved her husband very much and spent almost all her time with him.

dialogue.content: ほかの交友関係は、それほど広くないんです
dialogue.English: She didn’t have a very wide circle of friends otherwise.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。最後はご主人に看取られたのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. Was her husband with her at the end?

dialogue.content: 職場の人も、無くなったという連絡が来たのは私ぐらいでした
dialogue.English: Even among people at work, I was about the only one who received the news of her passing.

dialogue.content: じつは、最期のお話は、わからないのです。
dialogue.English: Actually, I don't know the details of her final moments.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・といいますと・・・どういうことですか?
dialogue.English: I see... what do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: ご主人からショートメールで訃報を知らされ、
dialogue.English: I was informed of her passing by a text message from her husband,

dialogue.content: はいはい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私は小さな子どももおり、
dialogue.English: and I have a small child,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一応医療従事者に入るので、
dialogue.English: and I'm technically a healthcare worker,

dialogue.content: このコロナ禍で
dialogue.English: so with the COVID-19 pandemic,

dialogue.content: お通夜は行きませんでした
dialogue.English: I didn’t attend the wake.

dialogue.content: お花だけを送ったのですが……
dialogue.English: I only sent flowers, but...

dialogue.content: あとから、
dialogue.English: Afterwards,

dialogue.content: はいはい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 私はなんて冷たい人なんだろうって、
dialogue.English: I thought, “What a cold person I am,”

dialogue.content: 後悔してます
dialogue.English: and I regret it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、今の状況下では致し方ないですが判断は決して間違ってはおられないと思いますよ。どうかそれ以上、自分を責めないでください。
dialogue.English: I see. Under the current circumstances, it couldn't be helped, and I don't think your decision was wrong at all. Please don't blame yourself any further.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます……でも、
dialogue.English: Thank you… but…

dialogue.content: でも?
dialogue.English: But?

dialogue.content: きっと、ご主人とばかり行動してたので、
dialogue.English: I'm sure, since she spent almost all her time with her husband,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お友達は沢山来てお別れできたのかな？
dialogue.English: I wonder if many friends came to say goodbye to her.

dialogue.content: とか
dialogue.English: Things like that.

dialogue.content: わたしでよければ、
dialogue.English: If someone like me would have been welcome,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すこしでもたくさんの人に見送られたかな、とか、
dialogue.English: maybe she would have been seen off by a few more people, or,

dialogue.content: その反面
dialogue.English: On the other hand,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 人があまり来ない方が
dialogue.English: maybe it was better that not many people came,

dialogue.content: ご主人は、愛するその子とゆっくりお別れできたからよかったのかな、とか
dialogue.English: maybe it was better for her husband to have a quiet farewell with his beloved.

dialogue.content: いろんな思いが頭の中をかけめぐり、
dialogue.English: All these different thoughts are racing through my mind,

dialogue.content: 夜も眠れないのです
dialogue.English: and I can't sleep at night.

dialogue.content: うーん、一言で言い表すと軽率な意見になりそうで私も言葉を選んでしまいます。お気持ちは察することができます。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I'm choosing my words carefully because anything I say might sound glib. I can imagine how you must feel.

dialogue.content: 最後に会ったのは3年前。私が結婚して職場を離れすぐ妊娠。
dialogue.English: The last time I saw her was three years ago. I got married, left the workplace, and got pregnant soon after.

dialogue.content: 彼女も
dialogue.English: She also,

dialogue.content: 「不妊治療に専念するため、夜勤の仕事やめるんだ」
dialogue.English: said, "I'm quitting my night shift job to focus on fertility treatments,"

dialogue.content: ということで辞め、
dialogue.English: and she quit.

dialogue.content: 以降、私の育児やコロナで、
dialogue.English: After that, with me raising my child and with the pandemic,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 連絡もほとんどとらず、次の連絡が訃報だったのです
dialogue.English: we hardly kept in touch, and the next message I got was the news of her death.

dialogue.content: 奇遇にも2回も同じ職場で再会して、飲みに行ったりする仲だったのに。
dialogue.English: And this was after we had coincidentally reunited at the same workplace twice and were close enough to go out for drinks.

dialogue.content: 私は冷たかったのかな？
dialogue.English: Was I cold?

dialogue.content: 彼女に何かできたろうかると思うと、
dialogue.English: When I think there might have been something I could have done for her,

dialogue.content: ⬆️彼女に何かできたろうかと思うと
dialogue.English: When I think there might have been something I could have done for her,

dialogue.content: 悔しいです
dialogue.English: I feel so frustrated and regretful.

dialogue.content: その方も苦しんでおられたのでしようが、強い方でもあったのでしようね。でもあなたの気持ちも痛いほどわかりますし、伝わります。
dialogue.English: She must have been suffering, but she also must have been a very strong person. But I can also feel your pain; it comes through very clearly.

dialogue.content: その子、すごい天然なんですが、芯が強くてとてもしっかりした子なんです。
dialogue.English: She was endearingly natural and a bit quirky, but she had a strong core and was very dependable.

dialogue.content: 生前にその方と何か良い思い出や楽しかったことなどはあるのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: Are there any good memories or enjoyable moments you shared with her during her life?

dialogue.content: その後、不妊治療は成功したのか否か、それすらもわからない
dialogue.English: I don’t even know whether her fertility treatment succeeded after that or not.

dialogue.content: 思い出は、
dialogue.English: As for memories,

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 思いでは?
dialogue.English: And your memories?

dialogue.content: 一緒に困難ケースをたたかった、
dialogue.English: We fought through difficult cases together,

dialogue.content: そして、ほとんどご主人としか出歩かないのに、
dialogue.English: and even though she almost never went out with anyone but her husband,

dialogue.content: 私とは飲みに出かけてくれた
dialogue.English: she would still go out for drinks with me.

dialogue.content: 思い出はたくさん出てきます。
dialogue.English: So many memories are coming back to me.

dialogue.content: 良い、お友達だったんですね。
dialogue.English: She was a good friend, wasn't she?

dialogue.content: 膵臓癌、ほんとにすごく痛かったと思うんです。医者がなりたくない癌の、ナンバーワンとききます
dialogue.English: I think pancreatic cancer must have been incredibly painful. I’ve heard it’s the number one cancer that doctors themselves would least want to get.

dialogue.content: きっと、弱音吐かずにがんばったんだなって……もう、想像でしかないですが。
dialogue.English: I'm sure she endured it without complaining... though I can only imagine.

dialogue.content: LINEからも、いなくなってました
dialogue.English: She was gone from my LINE contacts, too.

dialogue.content: いや、その通りだと私も思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think you’re exactly right.

dialogue.content: そんな天然の・・・
dialogue.English: Such a quirky...

dialogue.content: 芯が強い・・・
dialogue.English: and yet so strong at the core…

dialogue.content: 膵臓癌、気づいた時はほとんど予後が悪いって聞きます。その短期間で彼女はいろんな身辺整理したんだなって。
dialogue.English: I hear that by the time pancreatic cancer is discovered, the prognosis is almost always poor. I realize she must have put all her affairs in order in that short time.

dialogue.content: 強い人ですね
dialogue.English: She was a strong person.

dialogue.content: そう。天然なのに、芯が強いんです。目鼻立ちがハッキリした美人さんなのに、いつもすっぴんで
dialogue.English: Yes. She was natural but had a strong core. She had striking features and was very beautiful, yet she always went without makeup.

dialogue.content: ほんと、強い女性でした
dialogue.English: She truly was a strong woman.

dialogue.content: 美しい人って、
dialogue.English: When I think of a beautiful person,

dialogue.content: 彼女のことをいうんだなって
dialogue.English: I think of her.

dialogue.content: 何も出来ない自分がとても後悔してます
dialogue.English: I deeply regret that I couldn’t do anything.

dialogue.content: 自然体の飾らない・・・そして強い人。ほんとうに美しい人。
dialogue.English: Someone natural and unpretentious… and strong. Truly a beautiful person.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか・・・
dialogue.English: Do you really think so...?

dialogue.content: そうなんです！
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly!

dialogue.content: そんな人が、なんでこんな早くに……
dialogue.English: Why did someone like that have to go so soon…?

dialogue.content: 大好きなご主人と離れ離れにならなければならなかったのか
dialogue.English: Why did she have to be separated from the husband she loved so much?

dialogue.content: そんな強い人が・・・あなたには何もメッセージを残さず・・・そしてお別れしたわけです。
dialogue.English: That strong person... she left without leaving you any message... and that's how you parted.

dialogue.content: あなたに後悔をしてもらいたくてでしょうか?
dialogue.English: Do you think she wanted you to feel regret?

dialogue.content: そう。なんにも言わず、逝ってしまった
dialogue.English: That's right. She passed away without saying anything.

dialogue.content: 気を使ったんだと思います。そんな子です
dialogue.English: I think she was being considerate. That’s the kind of person she was.

dialogue.content: あなたを恨んでいたわけでもなく・・・気を使っただけではない様に私は感じます。
dialogue.English: I don't feel like she resented you... and I feel it was more than just being considerate.

dialogue.content: 先生は、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think, counselor?

dialogue.content: その強さを感じてほしかったし伝えたかったのだと思います。自分の死を通して強く生きる事を身をもって伝えたのだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think she wanted you to feel and understand that strength. I think through her own death, she was showing you how to live strongly.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's it.

dialogue.content: だから・・・あなたが後悔することを望んでおられないような気がします。
dialogue.English: That's why... I have a feeling she wouldn't want you to be filled with regret.

dialogue.content: もし、私なら最期の挨拶みたいなことするかも。
dialogue.English: If it were me, I might have said some kind of final goodbye.

dialogue.content: でも、彼女は
dialogue.English: But she...

dialogue.content: あえて言葉で残さずにメッセージを残したってことかな？
dialogue.English: Perhaps she deliberately left a message without words?

dialogue.content: 私に出来ることは、なかったのかな？
dialogue.English: Was there really nothing I could have done?

dialogue.content: 私はこんなに強く生きたから・・・元気だから・・・あなたも元気でがんばって・・・そんなメッセージとして受け止めてあげる事が一番、浮かばれるような気がします。言葉以上の本当に強いメッセージじゃありませんかね。黙って逝くなんて・・・
dialogue.English: "I lived this strongly... I'm okay... so you be well and do your best, too." I feel that accepting it as that kind of message would bring her the most peace. Isn't that a truly strong message, more powerful than words? To pass away in silence...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。言葉以上の強いメッセージですよね。
dialogue.English: You're right... It's a strong message, more powerful than words.

dialogue.content: でも、ひとつ言わしてほしい。
dialogue.English: But let me say one thing.

dialogue.content: 勝手に逝くな！
dialogue.English: Don't just go and die on your own!

dialogue.content: なんか、私に迷惑かけさせろ！
dialogue.English: Let me at least be inconvenienced by you—lean on me for something!

dialogue.content: その言葉の後に・・・あなたにできる事はそのメッセージを受けて元気に笑うことのような気がします。わたしならそうします。
dialogue.English: After saying those words… I feel what you can do now is to take that message and smile with vitality. That’s what I would do.

dialogue.content: それしかないのでは・・・
dialogue.English: That might be all there is...

dialogue.content: いまは、素直にそうは思えません
dialogue.English: Right now, I can’t honestly feel that way.

dialogue.content: つらい
dialogue.English: It's painful.

dialogue.content: 寂しい
dialogue.English: I'm lonely.

dialogue.content: 悲しい！！
dialogue.English: I’m so sad!!

dialogue.content: 泣くときは泣いてくださいよ。でも私も色々あるけどやっぱり、明日は笑うことに決めます。なので笑うと決めてほしいです。
dialogue.English: Please, cry when you need to cry. I have my own things going on, too, but I've decided I will smile tomorrow. So I'd like you to decide to smile, too.

dialogue.content: お時間になりました。
dialogue.English: Our time is up.

dialogue.content: 今日は気持ちが切り替わるところまでご相談にのれなかっかもしれませんが明日以降も相談の受付はしていますからつらい時は一人で悩まずにまた、ご相談に来ていただけますか?
dialogue.English: We may not have reached a point where you feel a shift in your feelings today, but we are available for sessions from tomorrow onwards. So when things are tough, please don't struggle alone and come talk to us again, okay?

dialogue.content: 明日はちょっとは笑うかもしれないけど、もう少し時間をかけて彼女のことは自分で消化させたいと思います。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: I might smile a little tomorrow, but I think I need a little more time to process my feelings about her on my own. Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 先生もつらいことがあるかもしれませんが、お互いがんばりましょう
dialogue.English: You may have your own difficulties, counselor, but let's both do our best.

dialogue.content: 今日は遅い時間からありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me so late today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそそうします。笑うと決めて明日を迎えます。本日は色々とお話を聞かせて頂いてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I will do the same. I've decided to smile as I face tomorrow. Thank you for sharing so much with me today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: それでは終了します。おやすみなさい。
dialogue.English: Then we'll end the session here. Good night.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。おやすみなさい
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Good night.
